The 132 cases retain only relative seconds, prior state, five-minute-boundary
membership and reference expected assessment/identity from the three frozen
R6-B parameter vector files (44 cases each). All identities use replay encoding:
-1 unknown, 0 pass, 1 rear. No real account/group/model/session identifiers or
absolute timestamps are retained. The source prior states omit level/admissions;
these fixtures test identity transitions only. Ladder/history are covered by the
synthetic table tests. The input event is gated through Due before calling Step.
